canonicalContract.factory: captureReportContext(timeZone, until?=captureTime); canonical helper floors capture time to last completed15-minute UTC boundary
canonicalContract.responseFields: flat period/timeZone/from/until/buckets(start/end/partial); DashboardHistory buckets additionally retain kinds
canonicalContract.lifetime: once per view/refresh; See full history carries same context
canonicalContract.implementationHold: No UI source changes or dependent intake until checked generated pin
canonicalContract.aggregateEnd: eventTime < context.until; in-progress quarter excluded; no sub-quarter filtering/interpolation
canonicalContract.consistency: render aggregate panels from the actual common consistent-read producer result; no UI snapshot framework
canonicalContract.lateFacts: every fact known at query time with eventTime < until; same context may yield additional late facts on a new query
canonicalContract.live: Now playing and existing2-second Live remain moving; Live returns its actual effective until/observedAt
